experiment: Katwijk Part4 SE(3) pose-graph SLAM (generalisation, no DEM)
honest_read: SE(3) estimator (concurrent dart.se3_pose_graph) run on Katwijk Part4. VO is already sub-metre on the 76m loop so loop closure / SE(3) orientation optimisation has almost no drift to remove (unlike S3LI 93->8m); this confirms the SE(3) estimator generalises to a 2nd real rover, not that it corrects drift here.
